title: [maintainer] enqueue I/O errors silently discarded
description: NNTP/JMAP enqueue failures are logged at warn level only (relay_queue.rs:84, email/set.rs:218, post/smtp_relay.rs:84). Transient I/O errors (disk full, queue dir not writable) cause silent message loss — article is accepted to client, but never written to queue. Operator won't know unless actively monitoring warn logs. Need: change log level to error, add metric counter, or fail the request back to client.
